ABOUT NEW BHARAT JAANCH GHAR

A laboratory with a long-standing local presence.

Established in 2008, New Bharat Jaanch Ghar serves the Runni Saidpur, Sitamarhi area. The laboratory describes itself as one of the oldest laboratories in the nearby area.

Laboratory timing: Monday–Sunday, 7:00 AM–7:00 PM.

At a glance

Founded: 2008

Home collection: 7:00 AM–5:00 PM

Address: Hospital Road, Runni Saidpur, Sitamarhi, Bihar
